content: Browse API ItemSummary type: price.value (string decimal) + price.currency for item price; shippingOptions is an array, each entry has shippingCost.value + shippingCost.currency for shipping cost of that option. shippingCost.value is '0.00' for free shipping (not absent/null) - safe to always read shippingOptions[0].shippingCost.value and add to price.value for a total-cost computation, defaulting to 0 if shippingOptions array is empty.
